invariant_text: Every distribution extracts to an independent repository with preserved canonical source and package digests.
method: Copied src/python/ubl/ verbatim (186 files, excluding build/.pytest_cache/etc.) into a fresh OS-temp directory with no ancestor relationship to this repository, confirmed byte-identical against the original, built a wheel+sdist from that isolated copy with its own cwd (never this repository root), built a second wheel+sdist from the in-place source at the same pinned SOURCE_DATE_EPOCH, and compared artifact digests.
note: Clean on the first run for THIS gate, despite this format's own build/ directory having 155 stray files (the most of any FF6 format) -- the fix already applied to this gate's own _build() clears it before comparing. Separately, this format's own PRE-EXISTING reports/certification/ubl/reproducible-build.json was found stale and was refreshed this same tick using the now-fixed reproducible_build_gate.py -- the two now agree exactly. This file ORIGINALLY also recorded a THIRD, separate finding here about tools/run_package_install_proof.py producing a different wheel digest than this gate and reproducible_build_gate.py, attributed at the time to a build-environment interpreter-pinning inconsistency (system python vs .venv python) -- that theory is RETRACTED (see reports/certification/ubl/installed-wheel-gate.json's own retraction text): the real cause was packaging/python/package-matrix.yaml's own ubl entry pointing at the deprecated legacy shim, not an interpreter-pinning issue at all. Once that matrix entry was fixed at Event 327/442-era work, all three tools (this gate, reproducible_build_gate.py, and run_package_install_proof.py) now agree on an identical digest regardless of interpreter. This is one of product-goal.yaml's own completion invariants, separate from the 10-item gate list (installed-wheel, independent-oracle, corpus, security, resource, typing, documentation, compatibility, performance, reproducible-build). Not a certification claim -- the other outstanding program-wide invariant (all-six-co-install, already separately satisfied at FF6-EVENT-000322) and this format's own remaining obligation/gate work are tracked independently.
re_run_this_tick: FF6-EVENT-000451: independently re-ran this gate fresh, completing all 11 gate slots for ubl AND the entire nrrd/ora/ubl gate sweep (Events 419-451). Verdict unchanged: EXTRACTS_INDEPENDENTLY. source_file_count grew from 186 to 187 (matching the same +1 growth already confirmed for this format's own typing-gate at Event 447). The fresh wheel_sha256 (718fceb73655d8a070edeb46fe957287637f9d3c4b0c10764543d63a6349341b) is byte-for-byte IDENTICAL to the wheel independently built by both the installed-wheel gate (Event 442) and reproducible-build gate (Event 449) -- ubl reaches the same full 3-tool cross-confirmation already demonstrated for all 5 other FF6 formats, and this fresh match further reinforces that the old interpreter-pinning theory (corrected above) was genuinely a red herring, not a still-open finding. Found and corrected the stale, pre-retraction 'third open finding' text above (this file's own copy of the retracted claim had never been updated to match the correction already made in installed-wheel-gate.json) while merging the fresh technical data by hand, preserving all other pre-existing narrative content.
